motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Icon swap, theme feedback and route transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Violet primary action with AA-compliant white text in both themes.
components.css: .ui-button { border-radius: 9px; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: A flush 236px draggable navigation sidebar with a single right divider that reduces to a centered 76px icon rail; interactive descendants remain no-drag.
components.css: .sidebar-link { min-height: 42px; border-radius: 11px; } .sidebar-link-active { background: var(--sidebar-active); color: var(--signal-strong); }

components.name: Desktop Window Chrome
components.description: A frameless 40px drag layer with macOS controls over the flush sidebar and Windows or Linux controls aligned right; content top inset is platform-aware.
components.css: .window-titlebar { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto; height: 40px; -webkit-app-region: drag; }

components.name: Drop Workspace
components.description: The full processing workspace is the drop surface with a uniform 8px outer inset; its configuration panel clears the draggable titlebar.
components.css: .video-drop-workspace::after { inset: 8px; border: 1px dashed var(--border); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--background); }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: Flat bordered panel for settings, tables and task configuration.
components.css: .settings-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--background); }

components.name: Semantic Status
components.description: Theme-aware success, warning and danger states.

narrative.overview: A clear, calm desktop media workstation with restrained violet interaction color and rare lime activity signals.
keyCharacteristics: Thin boundaries and clear surface hierarchy

rules.name: Signal Rarity
rules.body: Violet marks interaction and progress; lime marks small live states only.

rules.name: Flat at Rest
rules.body: Permanent surfaces use tone or border; shadows are reserved for true elevation.

dos: Keep files, configuration, task state and results visually connected.
Calibrate light and dark themes independently.
donts: Do not use decorative gradients, glass or glowing edges.
Do not fill workspaces with unrelated metric cards.
